method: Human-agent inspection of matched-speed V7/V8 phase images and four decoded frames from the default-speed real recording; no generated or retimed imagery.

improvements: The head remains forward along the body during gait.
The broad grey/white underside flap conspicuous in the V7 comparison is reduced in the inspected V8 frames.
Start, walking, stop, and manual reverse-turn controls are functional in the local scene.
limitations: The far hind thigh still forms a broad fan-shaped stretched surface during swing.
Front upper-limb shape is still elongated and does not read as articulated feline shoulder/elbow anatomy in some phases.
Surface motion and torso/limb coordination remain mechanical; this is not a completed natural cat walk.
The closed-eye surface patch limitation from V6 is not addressed by this gait iteration.

scope: A comparable structural correction study; do not claim anatomically natural or production-ready animation.
